comment: options.c handler_versinfo() gives the three rows of its PICK_ANY menu the group accelerators '1', '2' and '4' (6586-6594). wintty.c process_menu_window() sends such a digit to group_accel while no count is pending, so "2" and "4" toggle "game name" and the branch row; "3" is no accelerator and starts a count that Escape stops.
